text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Surrender! You have nowhere to run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your mischief shall not continue under<n>this class
rep's watch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grr! I can't get caught now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Why have you switched everyone's right<n>and left
shoes? They're all gonna be<n>confused!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't do anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All I did was take the shoes out of their<n>cubbies
so it looked like they walked off<n>on their own.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I heard though. Everyone<n>was
complaining that their shoes were in<n>the wrong
order...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well I'm the one who put the shoes<n>back in the
cubbies!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I knew that leaving the shoes out would<n>just cause
trouble for everyone, so I put<n>them back at
Bakushin speed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What kind of villain goes around stealing<n>the
thunder for others' pranks?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So the culprit is Bakushin O, but she was<n>trying to
be helpful... What should a<n>hero do in a situation
like this?
